text: Program Description This program is taught in BFSU-Solbridge. Brief Introduction It is one of the best satisfying Universities in China. There is international faculty and international environment. Here, you can get the best Chinese business studies, and language culture. Chinese Business Studies is a well-tailored, economics-based, multi-disciplinary program focusing on specific areas relevant to doing business in China. China's increasing integration into the world economy and strong economic growth has provided tremendous opportunities for international business. To seize these opportunities, foreign enterprises face the challenge of adjusting their way of doing business in China. We strongly believe that understanding the evolving business environment in China, especially the political economy of China's policy-making, is the key to successful business in China. Teaching Objective The aim is to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. Main Course China Financial Systems Strategic Management Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette China Economic Reform Chinese Business Environment China Business Law and Taxation Chinese Government and Politics Doing Business in China Degree Awarded After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .
